# Part 07 · PagedAttention

**Engineering** · [Watch the reel](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DcoL-DgR3Io/) · Published 29 Aug 2026

> Why do LLM servers leave most of their GPU memory empty, and how does paging fix it?

A server can't know how long a reply will be, so it reserves a worst-case block of GPU memory for every request. 60 to 80% of it sits empty.

## The idea

- Split the KV cache into fixed pages of 16 tokens.
- A page table maps each request's tokens to pages anywhere in GPU memory, allocated as the reply grows.
- Waste drops under 4%, so more requests fit in a batch: 2 to 4x throughput on the same GPU.
